description: Header types and schema copies bundled with fair-bioheaders-java, by FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification release (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md). 'types' is the header-type registry: one row per type this reader knows, with the URL key rules V1-V3 match, the file key used in 'current'/'releases', the status ('released' for a contract published under a release tag with a row in the shared schemas/versions.json, 'draft' for a development contract readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane), the transport (embedded-header for a file-bound ';~'/'#~' header, embedded-records for records carried inside another type's header under an x- key), the containers a file-bound header may be embedded in (FASTA, GFA, GFF3; as the reference toolkit's validate_header_family, a header in any other container is refused) and, for a draft, the pinned bytes under 'draft'. 'current' are the copies of the specification main that raw-main URLs select; the release named there is the one they belong to. Each release entry points at a frozen copy of that release's schema. Two draft rows are registered (FHT and FHGM): neither has a released schema, a w3id alias or an entry in the shared schemas/versions.json registry, so their bytes are readable ONLY through the explicit rule V7 opt-in, only at the pinned commits and digests recorded in the rows, and only with a warning on every record read that way; registering a row is not a support or release claim (docs/STATUS.md, docs/CAPABILITY-MATRIX.md). FHGM is a records draft, not a header type: its rows pin the record contract, the transport overlay and the model-level rules (FhgmModels), and a carrier file is still routed by its own released FHGFF3 citation. A draft row never appears under 'current' or 'releases'.

draft.source: FHT-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no w3id alias, no row in the shared schemas/versions.json)

draft.carrierContract: FHGM carriers are admitted on either released FHGFF3 base by the pinned overlay's closed identity branches (maintainer dual-base decision, 2026-11-15): FHGFF3 1.1 (specification v0.5.0, sha256 20ce320f5d706f11ed21cdece4dfb56e3568b50be126e25b4016f46f2e8e416c) is the base the sealed suite vectors were observed against, and FHGFF3 1.2 (v0.6.0, sha256 1942be4cefc8b3a2537942c2252b45fbcef87a5532486e4fd0f5d4c540e0fbf9) is the base the suite's separate matrix lane (development/conformance/base_matrix.json) re-observes identity-rewritten twins against. Both frozen copies are in this jar, byte-identical to their tags; the matrix lane is not run by this library's draft job (see schemas/provenance.json drafts.FHGM.baseSchemas and docs/STATUS.md).
draft.source: FHGM-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no schemaVersion, no w3id alias, no row in the shared schemas/versions.json). FHGM records carry no schema field: they ride inside an FHGFF3 header under x-fhgm-models (FORMAT.md R15), so this row names the record contract, the transport overlay (its own commit and digest) and the carrier type - the file is still routed by its own FHGFF3 citation under V1-V3. The overlay admits both released FHGFF3 bases (1.1 and 1.2) as closed identity branches, per the maintainer dual-base decision of 2026-11-15.
